purpose: Defines the developer terminal experience, interactive TUI explorer, subcommands, diagnostic doctor checks, and multi-format outputs (Human, JSON, and TOON) for Lumen.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-cli: CLI entrypoints (status, refresh, sessions, session, categories, insights, weekly, export, doctor, daemon), TUI renderer, and formatters.
non_goals: Database write locks or background worker execution (delegated to lumen-daemon).
Active test suite running (delegated to prism-cli).

api_surface.name: CliApp
api_surface.signature: pub struct CliApp; impl CliApp { pub async fn run(args: CliArgs) -> Result<(), CliError>; }
api_surface.description: Top-level command line router executing read-only SQLite queries or issuing IPC triggers to lumen-daemon.
error_conditions: CliError::DaemonNotRunning if IPC commands fail to reach daemon socket
CliError::DatabaseNotFound if SQLite database has not been initialized

api_surface.name: DoctorEngine
api_surface.signature: pub struct DoctorEngine; impl DoctorEngine { pub fn run_checks(fix: bool) -> DoctorReport; }
api_surface.description: Runs diagnostic self-checks verifying SQLite WAL health, daemon PID status, LaunchAgent registration, hook installations, and provider directory permissions.

api_surface.name: ToonFormatter
api_surface.signature: pub struct ToonFormatter; impl ToonFormatter { pub fn format_sessions(sessions: &[SessionSummaryReadModel]) -> String; pub fn format_findings(findings: &[FindingReadModel]) -> String; }
api_surface.description: Formats session and finding lists as Token-Optimized Object Notation (TOON) using michi-toon to cut token consumption by 60% for agent consumption.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN lumen status is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL display daemon state, queue depth, SQLite DB size, total spend, and cache hit ratio in under 5 milliseconds.
WHEN lumen refresh is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL send an IPC trigger to the daemon and wait synchronously until all queued sessions are ingested.
WHEN any view command is executed with --json, THE SYSTEM SHALL output valid JSON conforming byte-for-byte to the shared read model schema.
WHEN any view command is executed with --toon, THE SYSTEM SHALL render tabular data in Token-Optimized Object Notation via michi-toon.
WHEN lumen session <id> is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL display session metadata, 4-tier token balance sheet, turn latency waterfall, and loop anomaly alerts.
WHEN lumen weekly is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL display a 7-day rollup of sessions, active coding time, token spend, and git commits grouped by repository.
WHEN lumen doctor is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL evaluate daemon health, SQLite integrity, hook registrations, and provider directory permissions, returning pass/fail indicators for each check.
WHEN lumen doctor --fix is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL automatically correct broken hook symlinks and repair database permissions without user intervention.
IF the SQLite database file does not exist when a view command runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL display a helpful onboarding error instructing the user to run lumen daemon install.

reasoning: Establishes the developer CLI experience, diagnostic doctor engine, and multi-format outputs (Human, JSON, TOON).
